decisions.reason: The source also establishes coverage of all approximately 40 App Store languages, but that effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Selecting all Google Play languages does not change the existing requirement for Android RTL layout support.
Selecting all App Store languages does not change the existing requirement for iOS RTL layout support.
The expanded Android language coverage does not alter the existing download-size optimization goal or its specified optimization methods.
The reusable tutorial-image localization method remains valid unchanged regardless of the selected number of languages.
The language-coverage choice does not modify Android API level, dependency, or deprecated-API modernization requirements.
The App Store language selection does not change the existing iOS download-size optimization requirement.
The language-coverage decision does not alter iOS version support, UIWebView replacement, or API modernization requirements.
The choice of Android localization languages has no effect on the requirement to remove unused sensitive permissions.
The selected language coverage does not change the existing requirement to use iOS App Thinning.
